sqlite_access.transaction: BEGIN read snapshot, rollback, close before filesystem result checks

CPU_ledger.accounting_code_rule: Terminal attempts contribute charged_cpu once; active attempts contribute separate leases/observed values. Actual totals are terminal wait4 values, not summed heartbeat observations.

scope_limits: No outer performance scores inspected or used for method scheduling.
PID/start/boot/lock and sealed-file hashes are checked independently by root.
Completed filesystem outputs are immutable job artifacts; live active jobs may advance after this consistent DB snapshot.
